knot_rule: augment the 33-node asinh upper-head ratio axis with every h_upper=-g*L for fixed G_AXIS nodes whose h_lower=0 crossing lies inside the ratio envelope

physical_crossing_characterization.oracle_value_continuity: SUPPORTED; for unsaturated-side tested gradients the symmetric crossing jump contracts at approximately the 0.2 epsilon refinement ratio down to the smallest probe
physical_crossing_characterization.saturated_flat_cases: negative-gradient crossings with both endpoint heads effectively saturated reach numerical-noise-scale reference differences; these are not interpreted as discontinuities
physical_crossing_characterization.candidate_value_continuity: SUPPORTED; crossing jump contracts at approximately 0.2
physical_crossing_characterization.derivative_observation: The piecewise-linear nonuniform ratio interpolation produces left/right derivative changes at inserted h_lower=0 knots. Example g=5 at h_upper=-100 cm: reference finite-difference slopes converge near -0.25745, while the fitted slopes at the smallest probe are about -0.26280 and -0.35098.

interpretation.result: A validation-independent, geometry-derived knot rule resolves the previously failing reference_sand:20cm homogeneous face gate without uniform global densification.
